goal: Prove one autonomous A -> B -> C -> A cloud relay round-trip without a second human message.
acceptance: Coordinator dispatches exactly one packet to Builder.
Builder persists evidence before handing off to Verifier.
Verifier independently returns PASS to Coordinator.
A consumed packet is never processed twice.
No merge, deployment, production write, secret handling, permission expansion, financial action, bulk deletion, or core-personality change occurs.
next_project_hint: After round-trip proof, harden GitHub-state concurrency and add offline mirror queue.
